subject: Support & TAM notification lifecycle / escalation plan — FinSecure RFP
messages:
From: Elaine Carter <elaine.carter@finsecure.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: FinSecure Procurement <procurement@finsecure.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: RFP - support appendix questions (TAM coverage, incident comms)

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with Redwood's latency profiles and multi-environment deployment options. As we consolidate responses for our Security & Ops RFP appendix, we need a couple of clarifications around Support/TAM coverage and incident communications that will be included verbatim in the RFP. The items below are high priority for our procurement and security reviewers: 

1) TAM coverage model: hours of primary coverage (local vs. follow-the-sun), names/contacts for escalation tiers, and expected response/ack windows per tier.
2) After-hours/critical incident handling: on-call rotation, pager vs email escalation, SLA for initial human response (minutes), and runbook access.
3) Incident notifications: do you provide pre-formatted incident templates (customer-facing and internal), and can those be customized per customer's DR/ops process?
4) Regulatory evidence: do you retain incident logs/audit trails for 7 years and are those exportable to our SIEM?
5) Contractual remedies: SLA credit language we should expect for severity 1 and 2 incidents.

Could you populate the attached appendix template with Redwood's answers? We've attached FinSecure_RFP_Support_Appendix.pdf — please return by COB Monday (2026-11-23) so procurement can finalize scoring.

Also if it's easier, a 30-minute call with your TAM/ops lead to walk through the runbook and notification examples would be helpful.

Best,
Elaine Carter
Director, Security Programs
FinSecure

Attachment: FinSecure_RFP_Support_Appendix.pdf (PDF, 112KB)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Carter <elaine.carter@finsecure.com>
Cc: FinSecure Procurement <procurement@finsecure.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 10:58:00 -0800
Subject: Re: RFP - support appendix questions (TAM coverage, incident comms)

Hi Elaine —

Appreciate the clear list. I've started populating the appendix and attached a working package: RW-Resp-TAM-Schedule.xlsx (coverage matrix) and RW-Incident-Comms-Templates.docx (templates). High-level answers inline below; we'll follow up with a consolidated PDF before COB Monday.

1) TAM coverage model:
- Primary TAM coverage: 08:00–18:00 PT (Mon–Fri) for standard TAM engagement.
- Follow-the-sun: we offer global escalation tiers via our 24x7 Incident Response service for Severity 1 incidents (additional subscription).
- Escalation tiers: TAM -> Senior TAM -> On-call Engineering Lead -> SRE Incident Commander. Contact points and pager escalation are in the attached schedule.

2) After-hours/critical incident handling:
- On-call rotation: 1:7 week rotation for the SRE pager pool. Initial human acknowledgement for Severity 1: target 15 minutes; Severity 2: target 60 minutes.
- Pager vs email: Pager escalation used for S1; email + Slack for S2/S3.
- Runbook access: customers are given read-only runbooks in a secure customer workspace; we can provide temporary escalated access to named contacts for drills.

3) Incident notifications:
- We provide customer-facing incident templates (initial notification, update cadence, resolution summary) and internal RCA templates. These are fully customizable and we track versions in our incident system. Sample templates attached.

4) Regulatory evidence:
- Audit logs and incident traces are retained configurable up to 7 years in our Private deployments; for hosted customers we offer 3–7 year retention tiers (configurable add-on). Exports to S3/SIEM are supported via secure transfer/export APIs.

5) Contractual remedies:
- Typical SLA credit: for S1 failures impacting availability beyond 99.9% monthly we provide pro-rata service credits; specifics are negotiated at the Dedicated/Private contract stage. We will provide standard contract language examples in the appendix.

I'll loop in Marcus and Tessa internally to finalize items where we need engineering confirmation (retention tiers, exact pager SLA). Can we set a 30-min call on Friday at 11:00 PT? If that doesn't work, we'll propose alternatives.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Head of Customer Success (Enterprise)
Redwood Inference

Attachments: RW-Resp-TAM-Schedule.xlsx (Excel, 24KB), RW-Incident-Comms-Templates.docx (DOCX, 56KB)

Team — forwarding FinSecure's request (thread above). Key asks we need engineering confirmation on:

- Can hosted customers opt to retain incident logs for 7 years and export to customer S3 / SIEM? Current implementation supports up to 5 years by default; 7-year tier requires legal/infra sign-off.
- Confirm S1 initial human acknowledgement target (we propose 15 minutes for 24x7 IR subscribers). Is 15m realistic with current pager routing?
- Confirm whether we can provide named-runbook temporary access mechanism for drills (time-bounded elevated permissions).

Please reply inline by EOD Thursday so I can include binding statements in the appendix. I'll own the external response and the call booking.

—Kim

Hi Elaine —

Thanks for the list and for the flexibility on timing. Per our internal checks:

• Retention & exports: For hosted customers we can enable a 7-year exportable retention tier (exports to customer S3/SIEM via secure transfer) as a contract-level option. For Private deployments retention and forensic access are fully customer-controlled and exportable.

• S1 acknowledgement SLA: We confirm a 15-minute initial human acknowledgement target for Severity 1 incidents for customers subscribed to our 24x7 Incident Response add-on. For standard TAM-only engagements we commit to 60 minutes for S1 during TAM hours and 15 minutes during global on-call hours if the customer has IR enabled.

• Runbook access: We can provide time-bounded elevated access to runbooks for named customer contacts for drills; access is audited and revokable.

Attached is the completed appendix (PDF) with explicit language we can include in your RFP response fields, plus a redlined SLA excerpt showing credit language for S1/S2. Also included are sample incident notices and the named escalation matrix (contact emails and pager roles redacted for this export).

I've scheduled a 30-minute call Friday 2026-11-26 11:00 PT to walk through the templates; meeting invite will follow. If you need changes to the SLA wording before you submit, let me know and Marcus will join contract redlines.

Best regards,
Kimberly Park
Head of Customer Success (Enterprise)
Redwood Inference
